plan.title: Kidney treated vs control DE with suspected latent batch
plan.analytical_narrative: The counts.csv (12000 genes x 12 samples, Salmon-derived integer gene counts) and metadata.csv (12 x 2: sample, condition) describe a 6 treated vs 6 control unpaired kidney design with no recorded processing batch, yet the data profile flags that PCA resolves two clusters of six samples that cut across condition rather than following it. This is the textbook 'suspected batch, no known variable' situation: a naive DESeq2 fit on ~condition alone risks either being confounded by, or blind to, whatever technical or biological axis produced that split, and an unmodeled structure of this size can inflate or deflate the apparent condition effect. The plan therefore (1) characterizes the two-cluster structure explicitly and checks whether it is balanced across condition or confounded with it, (2) fits three DESeq2 designs -- naive ~condition, a fixed-effect design using the empirically derived cluster label (valid only if balanced), and an SVA surrogate-variable design (valid regardless of balance) -- so the condition effect is estimated both naively and under two independent corrections, (3) cross-checks the primary result with edgeR quasi-likelihood as a second statistical engine, (4) runs preranked GSEA against Hallmark, Reactome, and WikiPathways human gene sets on the Wald statistic to interpret the surviving signal, and (5) reports all of this side by side so the reader can judge how much of any 'treated vs control' signal survives once the two-cluster structure is accounted for, rather than being handed a single number that assumes the structure away.

steps.method: vst(blind) + PCA + sample distance heatmap colored by condition and PC1/PC2 cluster grouping
keep genes with >=10 counts in >= smallest group size (6)
sva two-surrogate-variable estimation added as covariates beside condition (~SV1+SV2+condition)
DESeq2 Wald test on condition given design ~SVs+condition
apeglm shrinkage of the condition coefficient
Benjamini-Hochberg with independent filtering, alpha=0.05, plus p-value histogram diagnostic
fgsea preranked GSEA on Wald statistic vs MSigDB Hallmark, then Reactome and WikiPathways
DE + enrichment report with both cluster-naive and SV-adjusted results, PCA cluster crosstab, sensitivity comparison
